releaseNotes: Mandatory VerTv 0.9.76: subtle left-and-bottom poster fade in the separate horizontally swipeable Top 10 shelf, improving contrast behind the white outlined ranking numbers while preserving full-color artwork. Featured carousel, content routes, ranking, and playback are unchanged. 373 Android unit tests and two targeted emulator Compose tests passed (fade contrast and manual swipe/navigation). Isolated local artwork was used for UI QA; signed-in real-catalog Home and physical Samsung playback are pending.
releaseNotesEs: Actualizacion obligatoria VerTv 0.9.76: suave degradado oscuro a la izquierda y abajo de los carteles en Top 10, destacando los numeros blancos con contorno sin quitar viveza a las imagenes. No cambia el carrusel principal, las rutas, el orden ni la reproduccion. Pasaron 373 pruebas unitarias y dos pruebas de interfaz Compose en el emulador (contraste y desplazamiento manual).
